== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The term Wolf refers to several distinct entities and organizations within the narrative. Most prominently, it identifies a specific division of warriors who hone their bodies into instruments of battle by using [[Way|the Way]] to reinforce their combat abilities. Members of this division are ranked by stars, such as one-star or three-star [[Wolves]], and utilize specialized techniques to empower their attacks. The division also employs a standard-issue [[Presence]] for communication. Individually, [[Razael]] is a figure known as the Wolf who belongs to a [[Court]] and has interacted with characters like [[Judge Suriel|Suriel]]. Additionally, the name is associated with various monstrous or supernatural beings, including a creature described as having the maw of a wolf and rabbit-like ears, and a mythological beast that serves as a guardian of the [[Netherworld]]. In some contexts, the term relates to specific combat compatibility or individual classifications within a larger hierarchy of ranks like [[Fox]], [[Ghost]], and [[Titan]].}}
